title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Complete Edition
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#993, 2026-11-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.25, engine x64-crossover26.3-r28, D3DMetal, rated 3 of 5 after 9 minutes: the Epic copy. The sound runs slow, the animated rollercoaster isn't drawn, the game lags, and loading takes a minute or two. The same with WineD3D. On the Wine 10 engine it slows to a crawl before the legal screen. The environment had ROSETTA_X87_PATH set, which Highball 0.10.25 drops. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Playable with trouble in one report on an M1, the Epic copy, on the Wine 11 engine (r28) with D3DMetal: slow sound, lag, and the animated rollercoaster isn't drawn. On the Wine 10 engine it slows to a crawl before the legal screen. The Steam release also has a native Mac version.

knownIssues.symptom: The sound runs slow, the game lags and the animated rollercoaster isn't drawn (M1, Wine 11 r28, D3DMetal and WineD3D)
Slows to a crawl before the legal screen on the Wine 10 engine (M1)
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine gets past it
